topics.purpose: Define how multiple attempt outcomes reconcile into one request-level outcome without hiding partial/ambiguous external effects.

semantics.success_rule: Request succeeds only under the operation's explicit accepted-effect semantics.
semantics.external_rule: If external side effect status is unknown after timeout/failure, outcome may be ambiguous and must not be guessed.
semantics.idempotency_rule: Subsequent retry may query/reconcile accepted effect through idempotency protocol where available.
semantics.authority_rule: Reconciliation is evidence processing, not new execution authority.

invariants.rule: Definitions, requests, validation evidence, authorization decisions and concrete executions remain separate identities; only an explicit validated and authorized dispatcher path may create effects.

hard_gates.condition: last attempt result overwrites prior external effect evidence
